{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Building Code''' was a set of regulations maintained by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the construction of new infrastructures. Many of these codes were designed to accommodate the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] schemes, including the construction of secret passageways and the enablement of surveillance systems.
